text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen about 12% from Period 1 to Period 10, so I should review the portfolio’s risk and diversification rather than assume that holding unchanged is always appropriate.","The decline has been gradual, and I made no trades; I should avoid panic-selling while checking whether the reasons I own each stock still hold.","Given my age and limited account check-ins, I should keep suitable cash for near-term needs and use a simple, periodic review plan instead of reacting to monthly price changes."]}
